author: Karl Rock
description:
I thought I was simply saying “thank you” 🙏.

But this Pakistani man thought I was greeting him as a Hindu, and quickly corrected me: “We are not Hindu. We are Muslims.”

It was a genuine cultural misunderstanding, and a good reminder that gestures can mean very different things in different countries.

I was actually thanking a man who had helped me find a Balochi suit for my wife.

Have you ever had a cultural misunderstanding while travelling?
title: DON'T DO THIS IN PAKISTAN 🚫
